**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  [Testing] Await warm-up telemetry before lifecycle resets**

When the javaagent fixture executes this setup, `send()` is asynchronous and its span ends in `ProducerCallback.onCompletion()`; receiving the record does not synchronize with that producer callback. Setup can therefore return with a span still in flight, allowing it to cross the next `InstrumentationExtension` exporter reset. The setup-telemetry rule in `.github/instructions/java-tests.instructions.md` explicitly requires waiting for asynchronous setup traces before lifecycle clears. Add an appropriate trace-completion wait before leaving setup, accounting for the metrics-only library fixture, which does not produce these spans.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L20-L24](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/blob/a4ac6e3dcb9e4a7eba72ce1a3412cb4c0bbb1b4c/AGENTS.md#L20-L24)
